column2:
The Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) issued an 
NOV for administrative findings related to our Emergency Response and 
Contingency Plan.
column4: All findings were corrected, and the ADEQ closed the NOV.

column2:
The City of Chandler issued an NOV for levels of manganese above the 
compliance limit.
column4:
All findings were corrected, and the City of Chandler closed  
the NOV.

column2:
The Maricopa County Air Quality Department issued an NOV for 
administrative findings related to our operations and management plan.
column4:
Corrective actions were taken to improve documentation 
following the audit, and the County closed the NOV.

column2:
The California Department of Public Health, Radiologic Health Branch 
issued an NOV related to the qualifications of the Radiation Safety 
Officer for a field radiography unit, lack of written and practical 
examinations of a specific number of questions for cabinet X-ray 
machine users, and inconsistent annual interlock testing of cabinet 
X-ray machines.
column4:
All findings were corrected, and the California Department of 
Public Health, Radiologic Health Branch closed the NOV.

column2:
Oregon Clean Water Services (CWS) issued an NOV for a missed 
stormwater sampling.
column4:
The missed sampling had been reported to CWS prior to the 
NOV being issued, and no further action was required.

column2:
The Department of Environmental Waste Inspection issued an NOV for 
four improperly labeled waste drums.
column4:
The waste drum labels were corrected immediately during the 
inspection, and no further action was required.

column2:
The Santa Clara Fire Department issued an NOV for findings related to 
our fuel containment procedures and infrastructure.
column4:
We are in the process of addressing all findings and expect to 
close the NOV within the appropriate time frame.
